data.title: Linda gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Dec 18, 2023

## [It’s a shame](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6580908e91d880944ac843ac)
It’s a shame. I like their stuff but hate the customer service. Waited on two orders, ordered separately. Waited weeks and weeks for arrival. Got one (candlestick holder) still waiting on the 2nd (candlestick holder). Absolutely no communication, you cant call them and to check on an order, you have to have an account set up. I finally got a tracking number, but it says no info available yet….after days. Done with L & G. Too many others out there with much better service.

December 18, 2023

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Dec 19, 2023

Hello Linda, we’re so sorry to hear that you haven’t received the second candlestick from your order yet. We can see that one of our Customer Experience Specialists reached out to you yesterday, provided an updated delivery date, along with tracking information for the candlestick. We are also available on Live Chat Monday-Friday, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.
